honestGaps: The conflict layer is deterministic/rule-based, not an LLM/NLP engine. It resolves conflicts among already-normalized controlled signals; it does not understand arbitrary prose and does not fetch live data.
It makes no final factual judgment about any business — it preserves uncertainty and produces the safest governed decision.
Live connectors / crawling / scraping / autonomous browsing / private owner shadow pilot remain out of scope (frozen — see DEFERRED_BROAD_GAPS.md).
